title: Distributed Cache
prompt: Design a distributed in-memory cache like Memcached

steps.title: Clarify Requirements
steps.text: What is the expected key size and value size? I'll assume small values under 1 KB and a read-heavy workload.

steps.title: Design a distributed cache cluster
steps.text: We need a low-latency key-value cache that spreads keys across nodes with consistent hashing and survives node failures.

steps.title: Add LRU Eviction Policy
steps.text: Each cache node evicts the least recently used entries when memory is full. TTL expiry runs lazily on read and in a background sweep.

steps.title: Scaling and Failure Modes
steps.text: Add replicas per shard; a failed node is removed from the hash ring and its keys are re-warmed from the database.

title: Rate Limiter
prompt: Design a distributed rate limiter for an API gateway

steps.title: Clarify Requirements
steps.text: Per user or per IP limits? I'll assume per API key with a burst allowance.

steps.title: Designing the Rate Limiter API
steps.text: The gateway calls checkLimit(key) before forwarding; a rejected request answers HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.

steps.title: Token Bucket Rate Limiting Service
steps.text: Token bucket counters live in Redis; a Lua script refills and decrements atomically so concurrent gateways never over-admit.

steps.title: Request Throttling Flow
steps.text: Client to gateway to limiter to Redis; the limiter returns allow or deny and the gateway forwards or rejects.

title: Chat Messaging System
prompt: Design a real-time chat application like WhatsApp

steps.title: Clarify Requirements
steps.text: One-to-one and group messaging, delivery receipts, online presence.

steps.title: WebSocket Gateway and Message Queue
steps.text: Clients hold a WebSocket connection; messages are written to a Kafka queue and fanned out to recipients' gateways.

steps.title: Message Delivery Flow
steps.text: Sender to gateway to queue to recipient gateway; offline recipients get a push notification.

steps.title: Design a simple URL shortener
steps.text: Map long URLs to short codes.

steps.title: Store short codes
steps.text: A table of short code and long URL.

steps.title: Basic redirect service
steps.text: Look up the short code and redirect.

title: Idempotent Payment Processing
prompt: How Stripe designs idempotent payment APIs

steps.title: Exactly-once payment charges
steps.text: Network retries must never charge a customer twice; every payment request carries an idempotency key.

steps.title: Idempotency key store
steps.text: Keys and their responses are stored for 24 hours in the payment database so a retry returns the original result.

title: Notification Service
prompt: Design a notification service for email, SMS and push

steps.title: Notification fan-out workers
steps.text: Workers consume a queue and send email, SMS and push notifications with retries.
